Assembled 2026-10-25 from proofread BSB page files 00089-00099 at repository revision 176a2557: 203 measures, 11 surfaces and 43 systems. BuxWV 259 identity follows the existing corpus work index; staff roles follow the five-staff page encodings. Correction credits follow page-file history for Francy Häring, Jan-Raphael Kemnitzer and Egor Polyakov. DdT 1903 is the documented base source. Selective comparison on 2026-10-25 with the Uppsala Op. II print through STIMU 1991 supports the gamba E4 dotted whole at m. 114 (Viola da Gamba, Sonata I, Grave, printed p. 4, fifth staff; scan-0027, left page). A source-supported annotation and supplemental excerpt document this reading; no complete historical-print collation is claimed. Assembly preserved the musical readings, clefs and meters; subsequent editor-confirmed corrections are recorded in the MEI revision history. The m. 90 upper-keyboard lower-voice F4 is a documented conjectural eighth on the final eighth-note subdivision, departing from its apparent quarter-note form in DdT. At m. 163 the opening upper-keyboard A-flat4 is a documented conjectural dotted quarter, restoring 6/4 and the beat-3 alignment where DdT appears undotted. Inherited MusicXML ppq and dur.ppq were stripped on 2026-10-25 following the notebook workflow and the other assembled scores. Work-level correction was completed with Egor Polyakov in the 2026-10-25–26 editing session; the editor confirmed corrected status on 2026-10-26. Remaining report warnings do not imply uncorrected musical text; final publication sign-off remains separate.

Catalogue identity checked against Edition Guentersberg G133 (https://www.guentersberg.de/noten/de/g133.php). Six staff roles checked against DdT. The editor suggested STIMU for a placeholder annotation, but its pointer belongs to Op. II/6, m. 3, and provides no historical-source evidence for this appendix. A targeted digital examination of Uppsala manuscript Instr. mus. i hskr. 13:27, source 2090, violin II, was begun on 2026-10-20; the m. 156 reading remains unconfirmed. No full collation or exclusive earlier source history is claimed. On 2026-10-20 the editor approved the inferred subsidiary-voice allocation at m. 34, the conjectural C4 dot at m. 70 and the interim omission of the first eighth rest at m. 156 while retaining its D5 quarter; manuscript confirmation for m. 156 remains outstanding. The additional source pass corrected the gamba tenor-clef passage at mm. 28–40, the pitches misread a third high at mm. 28–31, and the keyboard B4 at m. 34; later C-clefs were checked individually. The editor subsequently approved a conjectural dot on the opening E4 at m. 70 as well; its following alignment space is removed without shifting later notes. The separate m. 28 clef annotation is removed because the repaired encoding follows DdT; the correction remains in revision history.
